description.value: Chivers Point is a small boat-in campsite on Wallace Island Marine Provincial Park in the Gulf Islands, reachable only by kayak or motorboat from Chemainus; a wild island escape with no road access and minimal facilities.

raw_osm.description: 9 tent pads of gravel, wood. Vault toilet, picnic table at each tent pad, food cache. No fires permitted.
raw_osm.description:landing: Sand, pebble, rock beach, rocky ridges at low water. Narrow approach. Beach mostly floods at high water. Exposed to NW.
raw_osm.description:other: Attractive. View from low ridge above tent sites.Bring water - available Montague Harbour Provincial Park, Dionisio Point Provincial Park. Hiking trails. Most popular of 3 sites on island for paddlers.
raw_osm.name: Chivers Point Campsite (BCMT)
raw_osm.reservation:description: Camping fees apply year-round. Pre-pay permit via Internet, but no reservable sites or pay at site. Fee $5.00 per person per night (2019) via BC Parks Backcountry Registration System.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Primary evidence comes from OSM tags, which explicitly describe a vault toilet, picnic tables at each tent pad, and a food cache, and note 'Bring water' confirming no on-site potable water. The fetched BC Parks Wallace Island Marine Park page rendered as site navigation only with no campsite-specific body text, so OSM tags are the authoritative source. The OSM reservation:description confirms a mandatory pre-pay permit via BC Parks Backcountry Registration System at camping.bcparks.ca.
concerns: Wallace Island is accessible only by water (kayak or boat); cyclists cannot reach this campsite by bicycle alone. Relevance is limited to multi-modal cycle-touring itineraries that include paddling the Gulf Islands.
The fetched website rendered almost entirely as BC Parks site navigation with no campsite-specific body text; OSM tags are the sole substantive evidence source.
Reservation fee data in OSM tags is noted as 2019 pricing and may be outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active BC Parks campsite open year-round; legitimately useful to cycle-tourists who are also paddling the Gulf Islands as part of a multi-modal tour.
enrichment_extras.notes: A secondary BCMT-specific listing is available at https://www.bcmarinetrails.org/map_site/12125 (OSM tag website:bcmt).

wow_evidence: wild island escape with no road access
